vllm.log_note: Contains NUL padding from late shutdown logging of the preceding server; current API PID is recorded.

limitations: Paired clients run concurrently on distinct exclusively leased MI300X GPUs; host/NUMA resources are shared with other work.
Clocks and power are not pinned. Per-run ranges are retained; no saturation or tail-SLO claims from 20 requests per cell.
Both configured token budgets are nonbinding for this workload. Plow uses 512-row per-request chunks and ordinary buckets128/512/1024; scheduling algorithms differ.
Stock ITL is SSE-event spacing, including Plow multistep bursts and an extra empty terminal choice. It is not GPU time per token.
Synthetic fixed-length prompts measure performance, not model quality. Fusion numerical qualification is separately matched against ordinary Plow chunk boundaries.
BF16 only. Plow FP8 decode is not yet a matched W8A8 implementation.
